name: Floating Circle Button
author: idevelopit

sections.description:
Elevate your website’s contact experience with the Floating Circle Button v1.1.0. This is no longer just a single button—it’s a comprehensive social hub.

New in v1.1.0:
* Social Hub (Multi-Buttons): Add multiple channels (WhatsApp, Email, Telegram, Phone, or Custom Links). When clicked, a beautiful fanning animation reveals all your contact options.
* Office Hours: Set your weekly availability. The button automatically hides when you’re off-duty so you never miss a real-time lead.
* Smart Nudge: Catch visitor attention with an elegant, animated speech bubble that appears after a customizable delay.
* GDPR Analytics: Track how many times your button is clicked with a privacy-first, opt-in counter. No personal data or IP addresses are stored.

Core Features:
* WhatsApp Personalization: Auto-generate messages with {{url}} and {{title}} tags.
* Premium Aesthetics: Professional fanning animations, pulse effects, and sleek hover tooltips.
* Device Targeting: Show or hide specifically on Desktop, Mobile, or Tablet.
* Display Conditions: Trigger by scroll percentage or time delay.
sections.installation:
1. Automatic Installation:

    • Go to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to ‘Plugins’ -> ‘Add New’.
    • Search for ‘iDevelop Floating Circle Button’ and click ‘Install Now’.
    • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.

  2. Manual Installation (via Zip Upload):

    • Download the plugin zip file.
    • Navigate to ‘Plugins’ -> ‘Add New’ -> ‘Upload Plugin’.
    • Choose the zip file and click ‘Install Now’.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • NEW: Social Hub – Support for multiple contact channels with fanning animation.
  • NEW: Office Hours – Weekly scheduling to control button visibility.
  • NEW: Smart Nudge – Animated speech bubble for better engagement.
  • NEW: Click Analytics – GDPR-compliant opt-in tracking for button performance.
  • FIX: Enhanced security with better output escaping and nonces.
  • FIX: Modernized timekeeping using wp_date().
  • FIX: Removed large node_modules from repository.

1.0.5

  • Maintenance update and minor bug fixes.

1.0.0

  • Initial Plugin Release.
